renmods

An R package to download, import, and filter data from B.C.’s Environmental Monitoring Data System (EnMoDs) into R. The ‘renmods’ package replaces ‘rems’ to support the new data system released in March 2026.

The EnMoDs dataset is licensed under the Open Government Licence - British Columbia.

Features

  • Download EnMoDS data and cache locally
  • Converts to Parquet files for speedy connections and filtering
  • Straightforward data connections, only to as much data as required to speed up load times.

Installation

If installing on Linux, see the troubleshooting section below for a faster method.

# install.packages("pak") # if not already installed

library(pak)
pkg_install("bcgov/renmods")

Updating

After updating, it’s recommended to remove your cache and re-download the data. The downloads will take a bit of time, but this will ensure there are no complications due to the update.

Note that will get a warning if you try to work with data downloaded with a different version of renmods.

library(renmods)
cache_remove()
renmods_update("all")

Troubleshooting

Installing duckdb on Linux is so slow!!!

Solution: First install duckdb from the Posit Public Package Manager for Linux, then continue on with your installation of renmods.

(ref: https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb-r#installation-from-cran)

install.packages(
  "duckdb",
  repos = sprintf(
    "https://p3m.dev/cran/latest/bin/linux/manylinux_2_28-%s/%s",
    R.version["arch"],
    substr(getRversion(), 1, 3)
  )
)
